rows.quote: The GWAS summary statistics for endometriosis was available on Leelab Pheweb (https://pheweb.org/UKB-TOPMed/pheno/615) for the UK Biobank cohort and on the FinnGen R10 (https://r10.risteys.finngen.fi/) for the FinnGen cohort.
rows.coder_note: Step 2, rule C4 first case: the sentence gives the UK Biobank outcome data as Leelab PheWeb at https://pheweb.org/UKB-TOPMed/pheno/615, the resource identifier (pheweb.org/UKB-TOPMed) that exactly one outcome row lists; the stated 4036 cases and 210,927 controls lie inside that row's per-code ranges, and no other identifier conflicts (step 1 does not apply). The sentence occurs twice in the source (rule I4); the occurrence in p006 was pinned with the helper.
